rules.basis: The SR-IBC and SR-IBU inverter sheets print the no-load loss as a bound, '<16W', which is refused until a figure is printed; the ML2420 controller sheet prints a range under the same name, which the registry does not ask of a controller.
The SR-EOT01S and SR-EOT02S manual states the battery's rated voltage as 12.8 or 25.6 V; the HYP sheets print 'Rated Battery Voltage', which the shared file reads.

The hybrid sheets state the charge current from PV and grid together, which is the most the unit delivers to the battery; the PV-only and AC-only charging currents on the same sheets are parts of it and are not read.
The LC2430N10H manual states 92 V at 25 °C and a higher limit at its lowest temperature, so this sheet's figure keeps the temperature it is stated at.
The HP, MC and MF controller sheets state the array's open-circuit limit under this name, 100 to 250 V, at any temperature.
The controller sheets state the PV power per system voltage as '450W/12V', which the parser refuses as two units in one figure; the figure is named so the gap says so.
